name: Crying Cat
look: A close-up photo of a white cat sitting beside a laptop, looking up at the camera with huge, glossy, tear-filled eyes and a quivering, sad expression. A ceiling light glows above it.
use: A reaction for sadness, heartbreak or being emotionally wounded by something small. The caption names the disappointment, and the teary cat shows someone holding back tears or crying over it.
slots: the sad or disappointing thing (caption above)
examples: When you drop your last cookie and the dog gets to it first

cat crying next to a laptop
